svg.text: TSPC positive-edge DFF (9T) for 1.6 GHz prescaler
Supply pins: VDD, VSS (drawn as supply symbols at each device pin; ground symbol = VSS)
Devices: GF180MCU PDK (nfet_03v3 / pfet_03v3 / ppolyf_u_1k / cap_mim_2f0fF); W, L in metres (u = um); bulk drawn to source where tied, otherwise tagged.
